What if you built a shark that can walk? Big legs. Tiny arms. Zero brain.
It takes one step. Then it walks straight through the garage door.
Day one. It walks your sister to school. Nobody bullies her ever again.
Day two. It's hungry. It walks to the fridge... and eats the whole fridge.
That was a brand new fridge!
Day three. You take it to the beach. It walks into the sea... and walks right back out.
Wait. Are you scared of water?
So now your shark sleeps in your bathtub. With a night light.
And that's why you never build a shark that can walk.
